d: Long, flowing platinum white hair is styled in a high ponytail with jagged bangs framing the face. The eyes are heterochromatic, with the right eye being a bright sky blue and the left eye a vivid crimson, both possessing a sharp, focused expression. The face appears as a mature youth with a slender, athletic build. The outfit is a form-fitting, futuristic black bodysuit featuring a high collar, armored shoulder plates, and mechanical gauntlets, accented with small red details and a white kanji character on the chest. Signature details include a black headband with small red spikes and mechanical armor plating integrated into the lower body.
